title: Catalog refresh and verified specification corrections
summary: Refreshed all 1,586 qualifying JLCPCB parts: 351 Basic and 1,235 Preferred Extended. No additions, removals, or tier changes since October 13.
changes: Updated 1,550 stock counts and 1,480 price records; independently rechecked the three largest first-price increases and decreases.

Independently checked the 14 substantive rating changes against the exact linked manufacturer sheets. Corrected leakage and resistor-description errors and restored typical/maximum, pulse-current, and pin-pair conditions in the displayed specifications.

Confirmed RP2040 C2040 remains ordinary Extended. Corrected its RAM-boot and clock guidance, LM2596 replacement wording, the selected ADuM1201 speed grade, ESD guidance, lifecycle notes, and the resistor drift example.
Updated the existing WS2812 selection to its exact WS2812B-B/W identity and V5-linked datasheet, including the longer reset timing and Standard PCBA-only restriction. Aligned the W5500 package label.
Preserved all 58 Our Picks selections and recorded that additions require explicit human selection. Strengthened refresh validation and updated the build dependencies.
caveat: Catalog collection, targeted specification review, and human selection are separate activities. The selected Our Picks membership and its August 19, 2026 selection-review date are preserved. Source snapshots remain available; prices and stock may change, and these targeted corrections do not certify every electrical claim in the catalog.
